claims.canonical_content: Remote work inevitably makes every organisation more productive.
claims.raw_span: Remote work inevitably makes every organisation more productive.

claims.canonical_content: Nine of twelve volunteers at one software company reported feeling more productive at home.
claims.raw_span: A survey of twelve volunteers at one software company found that nine said they felt more productive at home.

claims.canonical_content: The survey proves higher measured output in every industry.
claims.raw_span: This small survey proves that remote work increases measured output in every industry.

claims.canonical_content: The survey measured impressions rather than output.
claims.raw_span: The survey recorded self-reported impressions and did not measure output.

claims.canonical_content: All organisations should close their offices.
claims.raw_span: Therefore all organisations should close their offices.

relations.rationale: The survey is offered as support for the thesis.
The inference expands one small self-report survey to measured output in all industries.
The stated method did not measure the outcome claimed by the inference.
The recommendation is presented as following from the thesis.
A universal policy is derived from the universalised thesis.
